arxiv-2107-11610.title: Context-aware Adversarial Training for Name Regularity Bias in Named Entity Recognition
arxiv-2107-11610.creator: Abbas Ghaddar, Philippe Langlais, Ahmad Rashid, Mehdi RezagholizadehHuawei Noah’s Ark Lab, Montreal Research Center, Canada
arxiv-2107-11610.description: Abstract In this work, we examine the ability of NER models to use contextual information when predicting the type of an ambiguous entity. We introduce NRB, a new testbed carefully designed to diagnose N ame R egularity B ias of NER models.

arxiv-2201-08073.title: Corrigendum to “On subgroup perfect codes in Cayley graphs” [European J. Combin. 91 (2021) 103228]
arxiv-2201-08073.creator: Junyang Zhang, Sanming Zhou
arxiv-2201-08073.description: Abstract We correct the statements of two theorems and two corollaries in our paper [On subgroup perfect codes in Cayley graphs, European J. Combin. 91 (2021) 103228]. Proofs of these theorems and three other results are given as well. † † footnotetext: E-mail addresses: jyzhang@cqnu.edu.cn (Junyang Zhang), sanming@unimelb.edu.

arxiv-2209-13011.title: The effectiveness of factorization and similarity blending
arxiv-2209-13011.creator: Giacomo Camposampiero Loïc Houmard Marc Lundwall Andrea Pinto Group: Bonjour, Department of Computer Science, ETH Zürich, Switzerland {gcamposampie, lhoumard, mlundwall, pintoa}@ethz.ch
arxiv-2209-13011.description: Abstract . Collaborative Filtering (CF) is a widely used technique which allows to leverage past users’ preferences data to identify behavioural patterns and exploit them to predict custom recommendations. In this work, we illustrate our review of different CF techniques in the context of the Computational Intelligence Lab (CIL) CF project at ETH Zürich.

arxiv-2402-15614.title: Spatial Variations of Stellar Elemental Abundances in FIRE Simulations of Milky Way-Mass Galaxies: Patterns Today Mostly Reflect Those at Formation GizmoAnalysis ( Wetzel & Garrison-Kimmel 2020 )
arxiv-2402-15614.creator: Russell L. Graf, Andrew Wetzel, Matthew A. Bellardini, Jeremy Bailin
arxiv-2402-15614.description: Abstract Spatial patterns of stellar elemental abundances encode rich information about a galaxy’s formation history. We analyze the radial, vertical, and azimuthal variations of metals in stars, both today and at formation, in the FIRE-2 cosmological simulations of Milky Way (MW)-mass galaxies, and we compare with the MW.

arxiv-2405-01111.title: Mining REST APIs for Potential Mass Assignment Vulnerabilities Conference: 28th International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering; June 18–21, 2024; Salerno, Italy 28th International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering (EASE 2024), June 18–21,
arxiv-2405-01111.creator: Arash Mazidi, Davide Corradini, Mohammad Ghafari
arxiv-2405-01111.description: Abstract . REST APIs have a pivotal role in accessing protected resources. Despite the availability of security testing tools, mass assignment vulnerabilities are common in REST APIs, leading to unauthorized manipulation of sensitive data. We propose a lightweight approach to mine the REST API specifications and identify operations and attributes that are prone to mass assignment.

arxiv-2502-13507.title: The multiplicity of a Mori Dream Space Thanks: The author was partially supported by the I.N.D.A.M. as a member of the G.N.S.A.G.A. and by PRIN 2022L34E7W, Moduli spaces and birational geometry. Author’s ORCID:0000-0001-6191-2087
arxiv-2502-13507.creator: Michele Rossi
arxiv-2502-13507.description: Abstract . In this paper we extend the concept of multiplicity from fake weighted projective spaces, as considered by Averkov, Kasprzyk, Lehmann and Nill in 2021, to Mori Dream Spaces, exploring interesting connections between the algebraic, geometric, and topological properties of these varieties.

arxiv-2512-12918.title: Satisfiability Modulo Theory Meets Inductive Logic Programming
arxiv-2512-12918.creator: Nijesh Upreti, Vaishak Belle
arxiv-2512-12918.description: Abstract Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) provides interpretable rule learning in relational domains, yet remains limited in its ability to induce and reason with numerical constraints. Classical ILP systems operate over discrete predicates and typically rely on discretisation or hand-crafted numerical predicates, making it difficult to infer thresholds or arithmetic relations that must hold jointly across examples.

The research is quite important considering the number of eye diseases treated with intravitreal injections is increasing and injection of fluids into the eye can cause an increase in intraocular pressure (IOP), which is a major risk factor for glaucoma.

pmc-11425517.title: 96 Building the customer experience in sports services
pmc-11425517.creator: Paula Harmokivi-Saloranta, Tuulia Stellberg
pmc-11425517.description: PurposeThe experience of the service is not a conscious decision. Customer experience is built on the customer’s interpretations and feelings that they experience during customer journey. The customer experience is influenced by different interaction situations, as well as, for example, the physical environment. In sports services, customers and instructors are in various interaction situations during service journey.

pmc-11621731.title: Diet-related behaviors affecting health and substance use among children and adolescents
pmc-11621731.creator: Ji-Hyun Seo, Sochung Chung
pmc-11621731.description: Unhealthy diet-related behaviors and poor diet quality during childhood and adolescence are the main factors contributing to noncommunicable diseases such as obesity, dyslipidemia, diabetes, hypertension, and cardiometabolic syndrome. Unhealthy diet-related behaviors can become lifelong habits associated with mental health problems, including depression, anxiety, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, and substance abuse issues such as smoking, drinking, and other chemical compounds.

pmc-11677530.title: The Buckling Behavior and Reliability Evaluation of a Cable-Stayed Bridge with Unique-Shaped Towers
pmc-11677530.creator: Yaoxiang Jia, Rujin Ma, Xiaoyu Zhou, Benjin Wang
pmc-11677530.description: Buckling is a significant concern for cable-stayed bridges that incorporate a large number of steel components, particularly those featuring unique-shaped towers that require further examination due to the intricate internal force and stress distribution. This paper investigates the buckling behavior of a cable-stayed bridge with inverted V-shaped towers.

pmc-12397288.creator: Xiuxian Shen, Feiran Wang, Jie Hu, Xiangqin Bai, Jianfeng Jin, Xiaofei Yu, Xiang Yang, Maofa Yang
pmc-12397288.description: Omiodes indicata, a significant pest of legumes, impacts food security in tropical and subtropical regions of Asia, Africa, and the Americas Asia. However, the lack of high-quality genomes has limited our understanding of the ecology of O. indicata. In this study, we present a high-quality genome assembly of O.

pmc-12563021.title: Immunometabolic Dysregulation in B-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Revealed by Single-Cell RNA Sequencing: Perspectives on Subtypes and Potential Therapeutic Targets
pmc-12563021.creator: Dingya Sun, Dun Hu, Jialu Wang, Jun Peng, Shan Wang
pmc-12563021.description: B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) is characterized by the abnormal proliferation of B-lineage lymphocytes in the bone marrow (BM). The roles of immune cells within the BM microenvironment remain incompletely understood. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) provides the potential for groundbreaking insights into the pathogenesis of B-ALL.

pmc-12644816.title: Alzheimer’s Tau seeds-induced pathology enhances hippocampal extracellular diffusion
pmc-12644816.creator: Juan Estaún-Panzano, Anna Lovisotto, Claire Mazzocco, Carolina Piva, Morgane Darricau, Ivo Calaresu, Quentin Gresil, Vincent Planche, Benjamin Dehay, Laurent Groc, Laurent Cognet, Erwan Bezard
pmc-12644816.description: The extracellular space (ECS) is a complex, dynamic network occupying about 20% of the brain, filled with a cerebrospinal fluid-like solution rich in extracellular matrix (ECM) molecules. ECS properties regulate molecular diffusion, potentially influencing disease-associated protein spread in neurodegenerative diseases. However, its role in tau propagation remains unexplored.

pmc-13031231.title: Outcomes of patients with rectal cancer and pathological complete response as well as patients with tumor cell dedifferentiation. Two prognostic different groups of patients responding to pre-operative oncological therapy
pmc-13031231.creator: Tomáš Řezáč, Pavel Zbořil, Dušan Klos, Radek Vrba, Petr Špička, Lubomír Starý
pmc-13031231.description: IntroductionMultimodal treatment represents the standard of care for rectal adenocarcinoma. A subset of patients achieves a pathological complete response (pCR), while a different subset does not. While pCR is associated with improved overall survival (OS), non-responders suffer from not being treated in a way tailored to their needs and have worse overall survival.

pmc-13556903.title: 670. Brain organoids to in vivo brain scanning to identify brain targets to treat bipolar disorder
pmc-13556903.creator: K Kaya, V Ramirez, I Tachtsidis, I-H Park, E Jonas, H Blumberg
pmc-13556903.description: BackgroundBipolar disorder (BD) is highly prevalent, with global rates estimated to be up to about four percent of the population. It causes tremendous suffering owing to its acute mood episodes and its high suicide rate, among the highest rate of all disorders. Yet, its causes are not clear, and methods for its early detection and effective treatment are limited.

pmc-13577160.description: HUWE1 (HECT, UBA, and WWE Domain Containing E3 Ubiquitin Protein Ligase1, OMIM 300697), located at Xp11.22, encodes a ubiquitin ligase that is highly conserved across species. Genetic variants in HUWE1 described in multiple independent studies cause X-linked intellectual disability, including in the patients identified by Juberg, Marsidi, and Brooks.
